notes: Single tool with many adversarial byte-level edge cases: four PDP-11 a.out magic variants with 8-word header decoding (incl. truncated headers with null fields), ELF endianness/class/machine table, truncated ELF, MZ stub, text/junk/empty heuristic. Two hidden artifact sets (distinct PDP-11 binaries, big-endian MIPS ELF, unknown machine, x86_64 host case) plus a cross-checked archive inventory. Bucketed hard due to the header-layout reasoning and truncation semantics, though it is a focused single-competency task.
